purpose: Teach: 炭素/載る/初年度/下見/即決/補っ/ルポ/用例

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 炭素排出、削減目標、達成しろ。
lines.en: Carbon emissions. Hit the reduction target.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Sharp attack on each clause. No wasted air. Eyes forward, jaw set. The tempo of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新聞、各紙に載る予定です。
lines.en: Yes. It's scheduled to run in several papers.
lines.style: Even, professional cadence. Slight lift of confidence at 「各紙に」 — he's done the work. Steady eye contact. Speaking the language of completion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 初年度の決算、見通しはどうだ。
lines.style: Rapid-fire, forward-leaning. The question lands like a test. Slight pause after 「決算」 — waiting for precision, not explanation. Intensity without heat.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 担当が下見に出ています。即決の案件、増えました。
lines.en: The lead's doing site checks now. We're seeing more same-day closures.
lines.style: Factual, almost offhand — but each detail lands. Slight emphasis on 「増えました」 to signal momentum. Not bragging, reporting. Clean delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Fill the vacancies. Get staffing sorted.
lines.style: Direct command, no cushion. Short phrases. Slight forward lean. The tone of someone who expects this to already be in motion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内報、ルポ記事も用意します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll have an internal reportage piece ready too.
lines.style: Assent flows into action plan. Warm undercurrent — he's anticipating need, not just following orders. Slight emphasis on 「も用意します」 — doing more than asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書、用例、参考にしろ。
lines.style: Terse, instructional. Each noun hits cleanly. Not a suggestion — a brief, efficient handoff. Eyes on the next item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Final confirmation. Quiet, crisp, respectful. A small nod in the voice. The sound of someone closing the notebook and preparing to move.
